_doc: gen_bars.py pins: the pair stage per key (tube zeta_r + flag, the solved BarTube, sigma clamp / weak flags, the f0 peak (ms), wt, bartube.pair_words' words and the stability grid), recorded where the approved tables were made. That stage bisects on eigenvalue-derived decays, which differ in the last bits between machines' LAPACKs, so the pins make the tables machine-independent. tests/py/test_gen_bars.py recomputes them with tools/eig4.py. Regenerate only on purpose: tools/gen_bars.py --repin (a reviewed table change).
